name: SHADOW paper test v6b: v6 with premium carry on 60 coins (Gen80 breadth)
registered: 2026-10-20, before the first v6b paper hour; runs side by side with v6, which stays the main book
what: Identical to v6 except the premium-carry sleeve uses the frozen Gen61 rule on the 20 pack coins + 40 extra Binance USD-M coins (research_data/binance_extra; live data for the extra coins from Binance public endpoints). Shadow test because Gen80 passed its own registered rule but failed the strict book rule (v6 TEST 2023-24 3.44 -> 3.14). Simulation only.

frozen.daily_stop: flat for the rest of the UTC day once the day's loss reaches 50% of the firm's daily loss limit (2% at HyroTrader 1-Step), exit 10 bp worse
frozen.costs: as in research: C* 7.5 bp, premium carry / trend / Weiss 5 bp taker, cascade 2 bp maker entry + 5 bp exit, real funding; deleveraging bounce 5 bp taker + funding
frozen.booking: cascade entry fee in the fill hour and Weiss legs as each bar closes (live=True); same totals as research
frozen.v6b_scale_note: 0.15 / realised vol of the point-in-time v6b series 2022-26 (0.8880, computed 2026-10-20)

frozen_ledger: Each completed hour is computed once, with only the data available at that moment, and never revised. Hours computed more than 2 hours after they closed are flagged late.

gate.minimum: 56 days of paper results and at least 2 Weiss expiry events
gate.reconciliation: recompute the period with the final data: hourly portfolio P&L correlation >= 0.99 and |cumulative difference| <= 0.5% of the account; otherwise find and fix the cause before going further
gate.operations: late or missed hours <= 5% of hours; no data errors
gate.performance: z = (paper mean daily return - backtest mean) / (backtest daily sd / sqrt(days)), backtest = v6b 2023-01..2026-09 at the same risk. GO if z > -1; EXTEND to 112 days if -2 <= z <= -1; STOP if z < -2 or the paper drawdown is worse than -12%
gate.honesty_note: 56 days cannot prove the edge (one standard error is about the whole expected return). The paper test mainly proves that the pipeline runs live without look-ahead, data gaps or execution surprises.
gate.shadow_decision: after >= 56 days: v6b replaces v6 only if its paper result is not worse than v6's over the same hours (difference of daily means >= 0) AND it reconciles; otherwise it is dropped
